import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem prime_dvd_iff_even_bounded_power_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p e : ℕ) (h₀ : Nat.Prime p) (he₁ : 1 ≤ e)  :
  (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ (2 * e) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  have h₁ : (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ (2 * e) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₂ : (n : ℤ) ^ (2 * e) % p = 0 := by
        have h₃ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by exact_mod_cast h
        have h₄ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ (2 * e) := by
          exact dvd_pow h₃ (by
            have h₅ : 0 < 2 * e := by
              have h₆ : 1 ≤ e := he₁
              have h₇ : 0 < 2 * e := by
                omega
              exact h₇
            omega)
        
        have h₅ : (n ^ (2 * e) : ℤ) % p = 0 := by
          exact Int.emod_eq_zero_of_dvd h₄
        exact_mod_cast h₅
      
      simpa [Int.ModEq, Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero] using h₂
    · 
      intro h
      have h₂ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
        by_contra h₃
        
        have h₄ : ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ n := h₃
        have h₅ : (n : ℤ) ^ (2 * e) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := h
        
        have h₆ : ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ (n ^ (2 * e)) := by
          intro h₇
          have h₈ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
            
            have h₉ : Nat.Prime p := h₀
            have h₁₀ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ (2 * e) := h₇
            exact Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by simpa using h₉) |>.dvd_of_dvd_pow h₁₀
          contradiction
        
        have h₇ : ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ (n ^ (2 * e)) := h₆
        have h₈ : (n : ℤ) ^ (2 * e) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := h₅
        have h₉ : (p : ℤ) ∣ (n ^ (2 * e)) := by
          simpa [Int.ModEq, Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero] using h₈
        contradiction
      
      exact_mod_cast h₂
  exact h₁

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem prime_dvd_iff_even_bounded_power_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p e : ℕ) (h₀ : Nat.Prime p) (he₁ : 1 ≤ e)  :
  (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ (2 * e) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  have hp : Prime (p : ℤ) := by
    apply Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr
    simpa using h₀
  have hmod :
      (n ^ (2 * e) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p]) ↔ (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ (2 * e) := by
    simp [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply hmod.mpr
    have hm : 0 < 2 * e := by
      omega
    rw [show 2 * e = (2 * e - 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h _
  · intro h
    have hpow : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ (2 * e) := hmod.mp h
    exact hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hpow

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem prime_dvd_iff_even_bounded_power_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p e : ℕ) (h₀ : Nat.Prime p) (he₁ : 1 ≤ e)  :
  (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ (2 * e) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : n ≡ 0 [ZMOD (p : ℤ)] :=
      (Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).2 h
    have hk : 2 * e ≠ 0 := by
      omega
    have hpow := hm.pow (2 * e)
    simpa only [zero_pow hk] using hpow
  · intro h
    have hpw : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ (2 * e) :=
      (Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).1 h
    have hpw_nat : p ∣ (Int.natAbs n) ^ (2 * e) := by
      have hnat :
          Int.natAbs (p : ℤ) ∣ Int.natAbs (n ^ (2 * e)) :=
        (Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs).2 hpw
      simpa using hnat
    have hpn : p ∣ Int.natAbs n :=
      h₀.dvd_of_dvd_pow hpw_nat
    have habs : Int.natAbs (p : ℤ) ∣ Int.natAbs n := by
      simpa using hpn
    exact Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mp habs

import Aesop

theorem prime_dvd_iff_even_bounded_power_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p e : ℕ) (h₀ : Nat.Prime p) (he₁ : 1 ≤ e)  :
  (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ (2 * e) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact dvd_pow h
      (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.mul_pos (by norm_num) (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt he₁)))
  · intro h
    apply Int.natCast_dvd.mpr
    have hs : (↑p : ℤ) ∣ (n ^ e) ^ 2 := by
      simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm] using h
    have hpabs : p ∣ (n ^ e).natAbs :=
      Int.Prime.dvd_natAbs_of_coe_dvd_sq h₀ (n ^ e) hs
    apply h₀.dvd_of_dvd_pow
    simpa [Int.natAbs_pow] using hpabs
